title: Bucket histogram
prompt: The input is pair(w, xs) with bucket width 1 <= w <= 10 and values 0 <= x <= 49. Bucket k (k = 0, 1, 2, ...) covers the values v with k*w <= v < (k+1)*w. Return the list of counts for buckets 0, 1, ..., m, where m is the bucket containing the largest value of xs; buckets in between that receive no value have count 0. If xs is empty, return the empty list.
